title: Fix image loading failure in shop interface

requirements.text: Debug and fix the image loading mechanism in CosmeticItem component to ensure all product images load correctly from /assets/generated directory without displaying 'Failed to load' errors

quotes: Fix the failed to load problem now

acceptanceCriteria: All 50 cosmetic item images display correctly in the shop grid
No 'Failed to load' errors appear on any cosmetic items
Fallback sparkles icon only appears if image genuinely does not exist
Image paths correctly resolve to /assets/generated with proper filename mapping

requirements.text: Verify that all 50 generated cosmetic item images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated directory with correct filenames matching the slug mapping pattern used by CosmeticItem component

quotes: Fix the failed to load problem now

acceptanceCriteria: All expected image files are present in the correct directory
Filenames follow the slug pattern derived from item names
Image dimensions match the expected format (e.g., dim_400x400)
No broken image references in the component code

requirements.text: Ensure the image slug mapping function in CosmeticItem and OwnedItemsView components correctly converts all 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetic item names to their corresponding image filenames

quotes: Fix the failed to load problem now

acceptanceCriteria: Slug generation handles special characters, spaces, and capitalization correctly
All item names map to valid image filenames
The mapping is consistent across both Shop and Owned Items views
Edge cases like items with apostrophes or special symbols are handled properly

constraints: Do not modify the backend Motoko code
Do not change the Internet Identity integration in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts
Do not alter the main.tsx entry point
Preserve the existing warm coral/peach color theme
Keep the image directory at frontend/public/assets/generated
nonGoals: Adding new cosmetic items beyond the existing 50
Changing the price structure or currency system
Altering the automatic income distribution system
Redesigning the shop layout or visual theme
